BEG
Segment: Beginning Segment for Purchase Order
Position: 020
Loop:
Level: Heading
Usage: Mandatory
Max Use: 1
Purpose: To indicate the beginning of the Purchase Order Transaction Set and transmit identifying
numbers and dates
Notes: Example: BEG|00|NE|BW-2026-0450||20260630~
Data Element Summary
Ref. Data Base User
Des. Element Name Attributes Attributes
BEG01 353 Transaction Set Purpose Code M ID 2/2 M
Code identifying purpose of transaction set
00 Original
BEG02 92 Purchase Order Type Code M ID 2/2 M
Code specifying the type of Purchase Order
DS Dropship
NE New Order
BEG03 324 Purchase Order Number M AN 1/22 M
Identifying number for Purchase Order assigned by the orderer/purchaser
BEG05 373 Purchase Order Date M DT 8/8
Date expressed as CCYYMMDD
REF
Segment: Vendor Reference
Position: 050
Loop:
Level: Heading
Usage: Mandatory
Max Use: >1
Purpose: To specify identifying information
Notes: The Bluewater vendor reference is required in the heading of every order.
Example: REF|VR|BW-88213~
Data Element Summary
Ref. Data Base User
Des. Element Name Attributes Attributes
REF01 128 Reference Identification Qualifier M ID 2/3 M
Code qualifying the Reference Identification
VR Vendor Reference Number
REF02 127 Reference Identification C AN 1/30
Reference information as defined for a particular Transaction Set

Position: 010
Loop: PO1 Mandatory
Level: Detail
Usage: Mandatory
Max Use: 1
Purpose: To specify basic and most frequently used line item data
Notes: Every order line must carry the NDC in the ND qualifier pair.
Example: PO1|1|24|EA|18.75||ND|4726195022~
